# Cairn

> Self-hosted Kubernetes PaaS control plane: deploy, secrets, databases, observability, SDKs, and MCP for AI agents.

Site: https://cairnpaas.dev
Docs (HTML): https://cairnpaas.dev/docs
Docs (Markdown corpus): https://cairnpaas.dev/docs/
Full agent index: https://cairnpaas.dev/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://cairnpaas.dev/sitemap.xml
Source: https://github.com/Mpratyush54/server-automation

## Facts

- What: Cairn is a self-hosted platform (PaaS) that turns one or more Ubuntu servers into a place to deploy apps from Git, run PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis, keep off-site backups, and watch logs, metrics, traces and alerts. It is built on k3s (Kubernetes).
- Where data lives: on your own servers. Cairn does not host your apps or receive their data.
- High availability: 3 or more servers keep running when one fails.
- AI access: a built-in MCP server gives AI assistants scoped access, with risky commands held for human approval.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://get.cairnpaas.dev | bash` on Ubuntu.
- Pricing: free Personal plan for personal use (up to 3 servers per install, 2 installs, every feature); Enterprise from $9 per server per month, billed annually. Details: https://cairnpaas.dev/pricing
- License: Cairn Source-Available License (source on GitHub, a license key is needed to run it). Not open source.
- Made by: Neural Nexus, India. Contact: legal@cairnpaas.dev

## Optional live API (when deployed on an app host)

- OpenAPI JSON: `GET /api/openapi.json` (not served as marketing content on this host)

## Crawl notes

- Public host serves marketing + docs only.
- Cache-friendly: `/`, `/docs*`, `/docs/**/*.md`, static logos/favicons.
- Do not treat authenticated app routes as public content.
